approval.scope: User confirmed the implemented role picker and avatar motion: one role section, no visible gender headings, numbers or names, no classic gallery entry, and preserved existing saved avatars.

approvedMasculine.reason: User chose to use the previously retained feminine and masculine sets and add them without deleting or replacing existing running avatars.

rejectedIdentityStudy.criteria: Distinct permanent face proportions, feature placement, and silhouettes with comparable natural expressions. Color, emotion, occupational labels, or accessories alone do not establish identity.
rejectedIdentityStudy.reason: User rejected this set as ugly. Exaggerated anatomy and literal portrait features lost the appeal of the retained graphic art direction. Withdrawn from the current review.

unusedAbcStudy.criteria: Retain the appealing abstract graphic style while developing recognizable character identities through feature design and composition. Do not force exaggerated anatomy or rely solely on changing expressions.

supersedes: Retain the selected twelve graphic designs and existing saved avatars. Latest UI direction unifies the picker under roles, removes the classic gallery, and shows no gender headings, numbers or names.
notes: Add state-driven whole-character motion with per-character timing. Preserve companion/portrait definitions, defaults and selected appearances. Saved classic portraits still render although the gallery is no longer offered. Source PNGs are unchanged. No production data is changed.
